longTitle.officialTitle: To reauthorize certain provisions of the Public Health Service Act relating to autism, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Autism Collaboration, Accountability, Research, Education, and Support Act of 2014” or the “Autism CARES Act of 2014”.

subsection.heading: In general.—
subsection.content: The Secretary of Health and Human Services shall designate an existing official within the Department of Health and Human Services to oversee, in consultation with the Secretaries of Defense and Education, national autism spectrum disorder research, services, and support activities.

subsection.heading: Duties.—
subsection.chapeau: The official designated under subsection (a) shall—

paragraph.content: implement autism spectrum disorder activities, taking into account the strategic plan developed by the Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee under section 399CC(b) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280i-2(b)); and
ensure that autism spectrum disorder activities of the Department of Health and Human Services and of other Federal departments and agencies are not unnecessarily duplicative.

section.heading: RESEARCH PROGRAM.
section.chapeau: Section 399AA of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280i) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (a)(1), by inserting “for children and adults” after “reporting of State epidemiological data”;

subparagraph.content: by striking “establishment of regional centers of excellence” and inserting “establishment or support of regional centers of excellence”; and
by inserting “for children and adults” before the period at the end;

paragraph.content: in subsection (b)(2), by striking “center to be established” and inserting “center to be established or supported”; and
in subsection (e), by striking “2014” and inserting “2019”.

section.heading: AUTISM INTERVENTION.
section.chapeau: Section 399BB of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280i-1) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (b)(1), by inserting “culturally competent” after “provide”;
in subsection (c)(2)(A)(ii), by inserting “(which may include respite care for caregivers of individuals with an autism spectrum disorder)” after “services and supports”;

in subsection (e)(1)(B)(v), by inserting before the semicolon the following: “, which may include collaborating with research centers or networks to provide training for providers of respite care (as defined in section 2901)”;

in subsection (f), by striking “grants or contracts” and all that follows through “for individuals with” and inserting “grants or contracts, which may include grants or contracts to research centers or networks, to determine the evidence-based practices for interventions to improve the physical and behavioral health of individuals with”; and
in subsection (g), by striking “2014” and inserting “2019”.

section.heading: INTERAGENCY AUTISM COORDINATING COMMITTEE.
section.chapeau: Section 399CC of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280i-2) is amended—

clause.content: by striking “intervention” and inserting “interventions, including school and community-based interventions”;

subparagraph.content: by striking paragraph (2);
in paragraph (3), by striking “recommendations to the Director of NIH”;
in paragraph (4), by inserting before the semicolon the following: “, and the process by which public feedback can be better integrated into such decisions”; and

by striking paragraphs (5) and (6) and inserting the following:
“(5) develop a strategic plan for the conduct of, and support for, autism spectrum disorder research, including as practicable for services and supports, for individuals with an autism spectrum disorder and the families of such individuals, which shall include—
“(A) proposed budgetary requirements; and
“(B) recommendations to ensure that autism spectrum disorder research, and services and support activities to the extent practicable, of the Department of Health and Human Services and of other Federal departments and agencies are not unnecessarily duplicative; and
“(6) submit to Congress and the President—
“(A) an annual update on the summary of advances described in paragraph (2); and
“(B) an annual update to the strategic plan described in paragraph (5), including any progress made in achieving the goals outlined in such strategic plan.”
;

subclause.content: by inserting “, such as the Administration for Community Living, Administration for Children and Families, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, the Food and Drug Administration, and the Health Resources and Services Administration” before the semicolon at the end; and
by inserting “and the Department of Defense” after “Department of Education”; and
by striking at the end “; and” and inserting a period; and

clause.content: in the paragraph heading, by striking “Additional” and inserting “Non-federal”;

in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by striking “Not fewer than 6 members of the Committee, or ⅓ of the total membership of the Committee, whichever is greater” and inserting “Not more than ½, but not fewer than ⅓, of the total membership of the Committee”;
in subparagraph (A), by striking “one such member shall be an individual” and inserting “two such members shall be individuals”;
in subparagraph (B), by striking “one such member shall be a parent or legal guardian” and inserting “two such members shall be parents or legal guardians”; and
in subparagraph (C), by striking “one such member shall be a representative” and inserting “two such members shall be representatives”; and

subparagraph.content:
by adding at the end the following:
“(3) Period of appointment; vacancies.—
“(A) Period of appointment for non-federal members.—Non-Federal members shall serve for a term of 4 years, and may be reappointed for one or more additional 4-year terms.
“(B) Vacancies.—A vacancy on the Committee shall be filled in the manner in which the original appointment was made and shall not affect the powers or duties of the Committee. Any member appointed to fill a vacancy for an unexpired term shall be appointed for the remainder of such term. A member may serve after the expiration of the member’s term until a successor has been appointed.”
;
by striking paragraph (2); and
by redesignating paragraphs (3) and (4) as paragraphs (2) and (3), respectively; and

paragraph.content: in subsection (f), by striking “2014” and inserting “2019”.

section.heading: REPORTS.
section.chapeau: Section 399DD of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280i-3) is amended—

paragraph.content: in the section heading, by striking “report” and inserting “reports”;
in subsection (b), by redesignating paragraphs (1) through (9) as subparagraphs (A) through (I), respectively, and realigning the margins accordingly;
by redesignating subsections (a) and (b) as paragraphs (1) and (2), respectively, and realigning the margins accordingly;

subparagraph.content: by striking “2 years after the date of enactment of the Combating Autism Reauthorization Act of 2011” and inserting “4 years after the date of enactment of the Autism CARES Act of 2014”;
by inserting “and the Secretary of Defense” after “the Secretary of Education”; and
by inserting “, and make publicly available, including through posting on the Internet Web site of the Department of Health and Human Services,” after “Representatives”; and
in subparagraph (A), (as so redesignated), by striking “Combating Autism Act of 2006” and inserting “Autism CARES Act of 2014”;
in subparagraph (B) (as so redesignated), by striking “particular provisions of Combating Autism Act of 2006” and inserting “amendments made by the Autism CARES Act of 2014”;

in subparagraph (D) (as so redesignated), by striking “6-year period beginning on the date of enactment of the Combating Autism Act of 2006” and inserting “4-year period beginning on the date of enactment of the Autism CARES Act of 2014 and, as appropriate, how this age varies across population subgroups”;

in subparagraph (E) (as so redesignated), by striking “6-year period beginning on the date of enactment of the Combating Autism Act of 2006” and inserting “4-year period beginning on the date of enactment of the Autism CARES Act of 2014 and, as appropriate, how this age varies across population subgroups”;
in subparagraph (F) (as so redesignated), by inserting “and, as appropriate, on how such average time varies across population subgroups” before the semicolon at the end;

clause.content: by striking “including by various subtypes,” and inserting “including by severity level as practicable,”; and
by striking “child may” and inserting “child or other factors, such as demographic characteristics, may”; and

subparagraph.content:
by striking subparagraph (I) (as so redesignated), and inserting the following:
“(I) a description of the actions taken to implement and the progress made on implementation of the strategic plan developed by the Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee under section 399CC(b).” ; and

section.heading: AUTHORIZATION OF APPROPRIATIONS.
section.chapeau: Section 399EE of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 280i-4) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (a), by striking “fiscal years 2012 through 2014” and inserting “fiscal years 2015 through 2019”;
in subsection (b), by striking “fiscal years 2011 through 2014” and inserting “fiscal years 2015 through 2019”; and
in subsection (c), by striking “$161,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2011 through 2014” and inserting “$190,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2015 through 2019”.
